data.name: Balavant
data.long_meaning: Balavant is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'bal' (strength, power) and 'vant' (possessor). This name is bestowed upon a boy to signify his inherent bravery and strength. It is a name of respect and reverence in Hindu culture.

in_sanskrit.name: बालवान्त
in_sanskrit.meaning: बल – strength, power, might; वान्त – desiring, desirable, longing; बालवान्त – one who desires great strength or power.
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who desires or longs for great strength or power.

in_hindi.name: बालवान्त
in_hindi.meaning: बल – शक्ति, बलवान; वान्त – राखना, चाहता, अर्थे के लिए चाहना; बालवान्त – जो बहुत बड़ा शक्ति या शक्तिपूर्णता का चाहना रखता है।
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has the desire or longing for immense power or strength.

in_tamil.name: பாலவாந்த
in_tamil.meaning: பாலம் – விரசம், உடல்; வாந்தம் – அவிர்க்குப்போத்து, ஆனந்தம்; பாலவாந்த – அவிர்க்குப்போத்து உடல் வைத்தல் வாழ்வார்.
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who possesses immense power or strength, or one who has gained immense power or strength.

in_telugu.name: బాలవాంట
in_telugu.meaning: బాలము – శక్తి, శక్తిపూర్ణ; వాంటము – చేది, చేదిపోయే, ఆశేశ్; బాలవాంట – చేదిపోయే శక్తిపూర్ణ శక్తియే.
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has the desire or longing for immense power or strength.

The name speaks of a powerful individual who is always ready to face challenges and defend his loved ones. Balavant is a common name among warriors, rulers, and heroes in Hindu mythology and literature, such as Bala Rama, Balarama, and Bali Chal Ravana.

The name represents the inner strength and courage that comes from a connection with the divine. Balavant is a reminder that no matter what challenges life presents, one can always draw upon their inner strength to overcome them. The name is a reminder that the true source of power and strength lies within, and not in external material possessions. The name Balavant is a constant reminder to the bearer to always tap into their inner strength and courage to live a life filled with purpose and meaning.
